objects.query: SELECT Description, DeveloperName, Language, MasterLabel, PrimaryObject, ProcessType FROM ProcedurePlanDefinition
SELECT DefaultReadContextMapping, DefaultSaveContextMapping, DeveloperName, EffectiveFrom, EffectiveTo, InheritedFrom, IsActive, ProcedurePlanDefinitionId, Rank FROM ProcedurePlanDefinitionVersion

SELECT Description, Phase, ProcedurePlanVersionId, ResolutionType, SectionType, Sequence, SubSectionType FROM ProcedurePlanSection WHERE ProcedurePlanVersion.DeveloperName = 'RLM_Quote_Pricing_Procedure_Plan'
objects.$comment: Keyed on SectionType;SubSectionType (the platform's per-version uniqueness rule; the query is scoped to this plan's version). skipExistingRecords: a rerun inserts a missing section at its CSV Sequence but never rewrites an existing one, so apply_procedure_plan_overlay's (PRM) resequencing survives (todo 316). excludedFromUpdateFields can't be used: SFDMU 5.8.0 also drops excluded fields from inserts.

objects.query: SELECT SubSectionType, ProcedurePlanVersionId FROM ProcedurePlanSection WHERE ProcedurePlanVersion.DeveloperName = 'RLM_Quote_Pricing_Procedure_Plan'
objects.$comment: Single-field key so the option lookup is a plain ProcedurePlanSection.SubSectionType reference (no $$ composite lookup, SFDMU Bug 4). Scoped to this plan's version, where SubSectionType is unique.
